//: Normally left blank. Used to set RTSP Server Address
RtspServerComment: ## Select RTSP Server > 1:RPOS RTSP Server 2:V4L2 RTSP Server by mpromonet (auto selected if MulticastEnabled=true)
PTZDriverComment: ## rposascii v2 talks to a PTZ controller such as an ESP32. See docs/rposascii-protocol-v2.md
PTZOutputComment: ## serial (UART or USB serial) or tcp (set PTZOutputURL to the controller, e.g. 192.168.1.50:9999)
PTZStatusModeComment: ## auto: use the controller's status if it reports one, else estimate. Also controller, estimate, off
PTZFOVComment: ## degrees. Only used if the controller does not report its field of view. Camera Module 3 standard lens, measure yours
